title: Query dispatch: API -> query.ServiceImpl -> coreplugin registry -> Service.QueryData
answers: How does a query request reach a core datasource backend?
How is a tsdb Service registered for dispatch?
body: Inbound: HTTP API -> pkg/services/query/query.go:ServiceImpl.handleQuerySingleDatasource builds a backend.QueryDataRequest and calls s.pluginClient.QueryData(ctx, req) (~query.go:325). For core plugins this dispatches in-process (no gRPC) to the registered Service, because pkg/services/pluginsintegration/coreplugin/coreplugins.go:ProvideCoreRegistry wraps each constructed *azuremonitor.Service/*cloudwatch.Service/etc. via asBackendPlugin into a backendplugin.PluginFactoryFunc keyed by plugin ID. Service constructors (e.g. pkg/tsdb/graphite/graphite.go:ProvideService) are supplied by Wire in pkg/server/wire_core.go:242-244. Actual execution happens in each package's RunQuery/QueryData (e.g. pkg/tsdb/graphite/query.go:RunQuery), which fans out per backend.DataQuery, calls the downstream system, and returns backend.QueryDataResponse frames.
